---
pagetitle: "Veritas AI"
# No `title:` -> Quarto writes no automatic title slide; the first `## {.cover ...}` slide is the cover.
# (Keep author/date for the HTML metadata.)
author: "Joseph Frimpong"
date: "2026-10-22"
# website: `slides web` publishes only when public: true (unpublished work stays local); web: <slug> sets the URL
public: false
format:
  argonne-light-revealjs:
    # ---- animation knobs (pick one per line) ----
    # fragments (bullets appearing one by one): true | false
    incremental: false
    # fragment motion: anim-samf.css = slide in 2ch from the right + fade (Sam's) | anim-classic.css = fade up
    # font: font-plex.css (IBM Plex, Argonne default) | font-helvetica.css | font-futura.css | font-calibri.css | font-opensans.css | font-avenir.css
    # covers.css last: the five cover families (.cover-a … .cover-e); swap the cover slide below with any block from cover-snippets.md
    css: [styles/custom-voice.css, styles/anim-samf.css, styles/font-plex.css, styles/ggpi-extra.css, styles/covers.css, styles/veritas.css]
    # slide change: fade (closest to Sam's) | slide (push) | convex | zoom | none
    transition: fade
    transition-speed: fast
    margin: 0.02        # reveal's outer margin (default 0.04); smaller = title closer to the top edge
    background-transition: fade
    code-copy: true
    highlight-style: github
    # slides-sync.html: live follow (audience), ?remote presenter, follow-along QR (key Q, `::: {.follow-qr}`)
    include-after-body: [styles/zoom-copy.html, styles/slides-sync.html]
    revealjs-plugins:
      - editable
filters:
  - editable
---

## Three places, no link

::: {.lead}
A scientist's knowledge sits in **three places that do not talk to each other**:
:::

::: {.places}
::: {.place}
![](figs/logos/zotero.svg){.biglogo}

**Reference manager**
:::
::: {.place}
![](figs/logos/obsidian.svg){.biglogo}

**Notes**
:::
::: {.place}
![](figs/logos/arxiv.svg){.biglogo}

**New preprints**
:::
:::

::: {.iconlist}
- ![](figs/icons/chat.svg){.ic} Chat assistants answer from none of them, and cite papers you cannot open
- ![](figs/icons/check.svg){.ic} Veritas joins the three on **your own device** and links every answer to a paper or note you can check
:::

::: {.notes}
The problem in one sentence; then what Veritas does about it.
:::

## Reading radar

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="62%"}
![](figs/radar.png)
:::
::: {.column width="38%"}
::: {.iconlist}
- ![](figs/icons/paper.svg){.ic} Starts from **the papers you wrote** and your interests
- ![](figs/icons/settingsRadar.svg){.ic} Watches arXiv, journals, **RSS feeds** and Valency Bond
- ![](figs/icons/filter.svg){.ic} Keeps only new papers close to your work, and says which of your papers each one matches
- ![](figs/icons/thumbsUp.svg){.ic} Like or dislike a paper: it **learns your taste**
:::

::: {.logorow}
![](figs/logos/arxiv.svg){.ic .logo} ![](figs/logos/openalex.png){.ic .logo} ![](figs/logos/chemrxiv.png){.ic .logo} ![](figs/logos/pubmed.svg){.ic .logo} ![](figs/logos/crossref.png){.ic .logo} ![](figs/logos/rss.svg){.ic .logo} ![](figs/logos/valency.svg){.ic .logo}
:::
:::
::::

::: {.notes}
On Oct 22 the radar kept 15 new papers from 18 sources.
:::

## Chat with citations

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="62%"}
![](figs/chat.png)
:::
::: {.column width="38%"}
::: {.iconlist}
- ![](figs/icons/chat.svg){.ic} Ask about your library, your notes or **today's digest**
- ![](figs/icons/quote.svg){.ic} Every claim cites a paper or note
- ![](figs/icons/settingsSources.svg){.ic} Sources on or off per question: Papers, Notes, Scholarly, Web, **Valency**
:::
:::
::::

::: {.notes}
"What was my reading digest today about?" is answered from the digest itself, with citations to it.
:::

## Links that open

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="62%"}
![](figs/reader.png)
:::
::: {.column width="38%"}
::: {.iconlist}
- ![](figs/icons/book.svg){.ic} A DOI opens **the PDF in your library**
- ![](figs/icons/open.svg){.ic} Else a **legal open-access copy** (OpenAlex), else the abstract
- ![](figs/icons/web.svg){.ic} Publishers that block bots and frames no longer break the link
:::
:::
::::

::: {.notes}
A paywalled ACS DOI opened its open-access arXiv preprint inside Veritas.
:::

## Veritas AI {.textslide}

::: {.lead}
Before the event we had built the Zotero and Obsidian tools. **During the hackathon** we built:
:::

::: {.iconlist}
- ![](figs/icons/settingsRadar.svg){.ic} the reading radar and daily digest, with tools the assistant uses to read it
- ![](figs/icons/open.svg){.ic} links that open papers directly, and the Valency Bond connector
- ![](figs/icons/book.svg){.ic} a knowledge base of 31 research personas, and Veritas itself as one open-source project
- ![](figs/icons/sparkle.svg){.ic} **Next:** persona agents: pick fields such as HPC and computational chemistry, and Veritas answers from each angle
:::

![](figs/icons/check.svg){.ic} **Open source (MIT):** [github.com/frimpsjoek/veritas-ai](https://github.com/frimpsjoek/veritas-ai)

::: {.notes}
Close with the repository link.
:::
